propositions: Current per-extra matrix job design requires 21 concurrent job slots, exceeding GitHub Free org limit of 20 total concurrent jobs, causing queue delays of 6.7-8.4m for macOS slots and extending Gerrit runs from ~21m to 41-47m
The workflow currently fans out 6 separate jobs (5 per-extra plus union) that individually hold checkout+setup+install slots despite only 0.4-0.8m of real work per job

The per-extra matrix set differs from _optional.EXTRAS: matrix includes 'mcp' (not in EXTRAS, no detection probe) and omits 'metrics' (in EXTRAS, currently has no per-extra CI), creating a gap in coverage

Collapse requires a single venv-loop job that runs 7 iterations (6 isolation: agents/eval/grounding/metrics/mcp/tracing, plus 1 union installing agents+eval+tracing jointly) with rc accumulator error isolation and absolute-path interpreter invocations to prevent activation stacking and silent test failures

Loop must maintain byte-identical clean-core-wheel job and update infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json to remove obsolete check names before emergency rollback attempts reference nonexistent checks
Test guards must verify loop contains rc accumulator shape with continue/exit and no activate calls, and that looped extra list covers all _optional.EXTRAS keys
